firm_data.firm_description: Constangy, Brooks, Smith & Prophete, LLP is a national law firm providing labor and employment law services, and has expanded into cybersecurity and data privacy. The firm has more than 230 attorneys across 21 states.
notable_facts: Expanded offerings in 2023 to include cybersecurity and data privacy services.
Clients include Fortune 500 corporations, small companies, and nonprofit organizations.
Rated as a Tier 1 firm by the Best Law Firms survey.

additional_contacts.name: Teresa Rider Bult
additional_contacts.title: Administrative Partner and General Counsel to the Firm

email.subject: AI for Constangy, Brooks, Smith & Prophete, LLP. Built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Scott,

Your expansion into cybersecurity and data privacy in 2023 signals serious growth across new practice verticals. Managing that alongside labor and employment across 230 attorneys and 21 states creates real operational demands.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of practices like yours: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in Atlanta. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
